en-US: Add visual architecture diagram notes with semantic components, system boundaries, labeled connections, automatic layout, revision history, and PNG/SVG export on Web and desktop; Android and iOS preserve the same data and provide a semantic read-only view.
zh-CN: 新增可视化架构图笔记：Web 与桌面端支持语义组件、系统边界、连线说明、自动布局、历史版本及 PNG/SVG 导出；Android 与 iOS 保留同一份数据并提供语义化只读视图。
